### Short answer
The passages do not directly rank “most important” S-parameter capabilities for Aerospace / Defense, and they only confirm that Randy Schnell’s role is “Business Development Manager, Aerospace & Defense Test,” not a specific S-parameter priority list for that market [22].  
### Confirmed S-parameter / VNA capabilities to emphasize
| Capability area | Confirmed capability | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| High-frequency S-parameter coverage | R&S ZNA models cover 10 MHz to 26.5 GHz, 43.5 GHz, 50 GHz, and 67 GHz, depending on model [38]. | [38] |
| Extended mmWave coverage | R&S ZNA67EXT is a 1.0 mm Vector Network Analyzer system covering 10 MHz to 110 GHz [30]. | [30] |
| 2-port / 4-port S-parameter architectures | R&S ZNA models provide 2-port or 4-port base units, with 50 Ω test port impedance and standard DC block [38]. | [38] |
| Dynamic range and sensitivity | R&S ZNA key performance includes dynamic range >129 dB specification without options, 147 dB typical with options, and maximum attainable range up to 170 dB allowing full 2-port correction [40]. | [40] |
| Low-level receiver sensitivity | R&S ZNA sensitivity is > –120 dBm at 1 Hz IF bandwidth without options, and –162 dBm measured with options, normalized to 1 Hz from a 1 kHz measurement bandwidth [40]. | [40] |
| Fast swept S-parameter measurements | R&S ZNA has a speed example of 96 ms nominal sweep time for 10 MHz to 43.5 GHz, 500 kHz measurement bandwidth, 1601 points, and 2-port calibration [40]. | [40] |
| Wide IF / measurement bandwidth | R&S ZNA measurement bandwidth is 1 Hz to 1.5 MHz in the base unit, and 1 Hz to 30 MHz with R&S ZNA-K17 increased IF bandwidth option [38]. | [38] |
| Pulsed-signal measurements | R&S ZNA-K7 supports measurements on pulsed signals, requires R&S ZNA-K17 together with a pulse modulator, and R&S ZNA-B7 is recommended [6]. | [6] |
| Phase-coherent multi-source measurements | 4-port R&S ZNA instruments support up to 4 independently configurable, phase-coherent, phase-controlled sources, plus a 5th source for LO supply [42]. | [42] |
| True receiver architecture | 4-port R&S ZNA models have 2 true receivers per port, 8 true receivers total, with no multiplexing; 2-port models have 4 true receivers total, with no multiplexing [42]. | [42] |
| Antenna-array / antenna-test support | R&S ZNA supports true parallel and coherent data acquisition, for example antenna array tests and antenna test systems, from 100 kHz [42]. | [42] |
| mmWave converter support | Optional rear panel LO out supports mmWave converters, up to 4 converters on 4-port models and up to 2 converters on 2-port models, without an external signal generator [42]. | [42] |
| Mixer / frequency-converter measurements | R&S ZNA software options include scalar mixer measurements, vector mixer measurements, group delay measurements on frequency converters without LO access, and mmWave converter support [6]. | [6] |
| Group delay for satellite payload / frequency converters | R&S ZNA can measure group delay of frequency converters without LO access, especially when traditional methods are limited by DUT internal LO drift or noise [32]. | [32] |
| Time-domain / TDR analysis | R&S ZNA software options include R&S ZNA-K2 time domain analysis and R&S ZNA-K20 extended time domain analysis including eye diagram [6]. | [6] |
| Deembedding | R&S ZNA software options include EaZy deembedding, in-situ deembedding, smart fixture deembedding, and Delta-L PCB characterization [2]. | [2] |
| Measurement uncertainty analysis | R&S ZNA software options include R&S ZNA-K50 uncertainty analysis and R&S ZNA-K50P uncertainty analysis pre-installed [6]. | [6] |
| Noise figure measurement | R&S ZNA software options include R&S ZNA-K30 noise figure measurement [6]. | [6] |
### 【推論】
【推論】If the Aerospace / Defense application involves radar-like pulsed RF, the confirmed R&S ZNA pulsed-signal option R&S ZNA-K7, increased IF bandwidth R&S ZNA-K17, and internal pulse modulator dependency are relevant capabilities to discuss, but the passages do not directly state that this is an Aerospace / Defense requirement [6].  
【推論】If the Aerospace / Defense application involves antennas, arrays, or mmWave front ends, the confirmed R&S ZNA capabilities for coherent parallel acquisition, antenna array tests, antenna test systems, and mmWave converter support are relevant capabilities to discuss, but the passages do not directly state that these are ranked as most important for Aerospace / Defense [42].  
【推論】If the Aerospace / Defense application involves satellite payloads or frequency converters, the confirmed R&S ZNA capability for group delay measurement on frequency converters without LO access is relevant, because the satellite payload passage explicitly names this R&S ZNA use case [32].

R&S ZNA67EXT
[[R&S ZNA67EXT]] 是 Rohde & Schwarz 的 1.0 mm [[Vector Network Analyzer]] system，依 [[ZNA67EXT_specs_en_5216-3743-22_v0900]] Version 09.00（July 2025）涵蓋 **10 MHz to 110 GHz**。

衛星酬載群延遲量測 › 來源列出的優點
- 可在 milliseconds 內量測 wideband signals 的 absolute group delay 與 relative group delay。
- Signal averaging 與 smoothing 可改善 carrier-to-noise ratio，在 cables 與 fixtures 導致 high signal path losses 時取得 valid results。
- 可自動補償 in-orbit measurements 的 Doppler effects。
- Frequency converters 的 relative group delay 可達 1 ns measurement accuracy，且不需要 reference mixer 或 golden device。
- Non-frequency-translating measurements 的 relative group delay 可達 300 ps measurement accuracy。
- [[R&S SMW200A]] 可內部彈性產生 MCCW signals 與 modulated signals，並可設定 carrier spacing 與 number of carriers。
- Deembedding function 可修正 measurement setup 中 cables 與 fixtures 的 frequency response。
- [[R&S FSW-K17S]] option 可量測 low SNR 的 wideband signals，透過分析 overall signal 的 subspans 改善 SNR 與 measurement speeds。

衛星酬載群延遲量測 › 方法二：R&S ZNA two-tone technique
[[Satellite_payload_testing_app-bro_en_5215-2120-92_v0200]] 說 [[R&S ZNA]] vector network analyzer 可用於量測 frequency converters without LO access 的 group delay，特別是傳統方法受 DUT internal LO drift / noise 限制時。

衛星酬載群延遲量測 › 測量原理
- [[R&S SMW200A]] 產生 multi-carrier continuous wave signal 作為 stimulus。
- Multi-carrier stimulus 的 tones 數量與 spacing / aperture 可依 DUT 需求調整。
- [[R&S FSW]] 的 group delay measurement 分兩步：
  - Reference calibration：generator 直接連接 analyzer，analyzer 判定 individual carriers 的 reference phase 與 amplitude。
  - Group delay and gain measurement：連接 DUT，analyzer 由 reference signal 與 DUT output multicarrier signal 的 phase difference 判定 carrier frequency range 的 group delay。
- 來源列出使用 [[R&S SMW-K61]] 與 [[R&S FSW-K17]] multicarrier group delay measurement application。

ZNA_specs_en_5215-4652-22_v2400 › 規格條件與資料定義
- Specifications with limits：表示 warranted product performance；以 <、≤、>、≥、±、maximum、limit of、minimum 等符號標示；compliance 由 testing 確保或由 design 推導。
- Non-traceable specifications with limits（n. trc.）：依 specifications with limits 指定與測試，但因缺乏可追溯至 national metrology standards 的 measuring equipment，product performance 不保證。
- Specifications without limits：表示 warranted product performance；未特別標記時表示數值沒有或只有可忽略偏差。
- Typical data（typ.）：representative information；若標示 <、> 或 range，代表約 80% instruments 在 production time 可達成的 performance，其他情況代表 mean value。
- Nominal values（nom.）：representative value；production 期間不測試該 parameter。
- Measured values（meas.）：individual samples 的 measurement results。
- Uncertainties：coverage factor 2，依 Guide to the Expression of Uncertainty in Measurement（GUM），並考量 environmental conditions、aging、wear and tear。
- 來源明確說明：non-traceable specifications with limits、typical data、nominal values、measured values 不由 Rohde & Schwarz 保證。

### Short answer
The passages do not directly rank “most important” S-parameter capabilities for Aerospace / Defense, and they only confirm that Randy Schnell’s role is “Business Development Manager, Aerospace & Defense Test,” not a specific S-parameter priority list for that market [22].  
### Confirmed S-parameter / VNA capabilities to emphasize
| Capability area | Confirmed capability | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| High-frequency S-parameter coverage | R&S ZNA models cover 10 MHz to 26.5 GHz, 43.5 GHz, 50 GHz, and 67 GHz, depending on model [38]. | [38] |
| Extended mmWave coverage | R&S ZNA67EXT is a 1.0 mm Vector Network Analyzer system covering 10 MHz to 110 GHz [30]. | [30] |
| 2-port / 4-port S-parameter architectures | R&S ZNA models provide 2-port or 4-port base units, with 50 Ω test port impedance and standard DC block [38]. | [38] |
| Dynamic range and sensitivity | R&S ZNA key performance includes dynamic range >129 dB specification without options, 147 dB typical with options, and maximum attainable range up to 170 dB allowing full 2-port correction [40]. | [40] |
| Low-level receiver sensitivity | R&S ZNA sensitivity is > –120 dBm at 1 Hz IF bandwidth without options, and –162 dBm measured with options, normalized to 1 Hz from a 1 kHz measurement bandwidth [40]. | [40] |
| Fast swept S-parameter measurements | R&S ZNA has a speed example of 96 ms nominal sweep time for 10 MHz to 43.5 GHz, 500 kHz measurement bandwidth, 1601 points, and 2-port calibration [40]. | [40] |
| Wide IF / measurement bandwidth | R&S ZNA measurement bandwidth is 1 Hz to 1.5 MHz in the base unit, and 1 Hz to 30 MHz with R&S ZNA-K17 increased IF bandwidth option [38]. | [38] |
| Pulsed-signal measurements | R&S ZNA-K7 supports measurements on pulsed signals, requires R&S ZNA-K17 together with a pulse modulator, and R&S ZNA-B7 is recommended [6]. | [6] |
| Phase-coherent multi-source measurements | 4-port R&S ZNA instruments support up to 4 independently configurable, phase-coherent, phase-controlled sources, plus a 5th source for LO supply [42]. | [42] |
| True receiver architecture | 4-port R&S ZNA models have 2 true receivers per port, 8 true receivers total, with no multiplexing; 2-port models have 4 true receivers total, with no multiplexing [42]. | [42] |
| Antenna-array / antenna-test support | R&S ZNA supports true parallel and coherent data acquisition, for example antenna array tests and antenna test systems, from 100 kHz [42]. | [42] |
| mmWave converter support | Optional rear panel LO out supports mmWave converters, up to 4 converters on 4-port models and up to 2 converters on 2-port models, without an external signal generator [42]. | [42] |
| Mixer / frequency-converter measurements | R&S ZNA software options include scalar mixer measurements, vector mixer measurements, group delay measurements on frequency converters without LO access, and mmWave converter support [6]. | [6] |
| Group delay for satellite payload / frequency converters | R&S ZNA can measure group delay of frequency converters without LO access, especially when traditional methods are limited by DUT internal LO drift or noise [32]. | [32] |
| Time-domain / TDR analysis | R&S ZNA software options include R&S ZNA-K2 time domain analysis and R&S ZNA-K20 extended time domain analysis including eye diagram [6]. | [6] |
| Deembedding | R&S ZNA software options include EaZy deembedding, in-situ deembedding, smart fixture deembedding, and Delta-L PCB characterization [2]. | [2] |
| Measurement uncertainty analysis | R&S ZNA software options include R&S ZNA-K50 uncertainty analysis and R&S ZNA-K50P uncertainty analysis pre-installed [6]. | [6] |
| Noise figure measurement | R&S ZNA software options include R&S ZNA-K30 noise figure measurement [6]. | [6] |
### 【推論】
【推論】If the Aerospace / Defense application involves radar-like pulsed RF, the confirmed R&S ZNA pulsed-signal option R&S ZNA-K7, increased IF bandwidth R&S ZNA-K17, and internal pulse modulator dependency are relevant capabilities to discuss, but the passages do not directly state that this is an Aerospace / Defense requirement [6].  
【推論】If the Aerospace / Defense application involves antennas, arrays, or mmWave front ends, the confirmed R&S ZNA capabilities for coherent parallel acquisition, antenna array tests, antenna test systems, and mmWave converter support are relevant capabilities to discuss, but the passages do not directly state that these are ranked as most important for Aerospace / Defense [42].  
【推論】If the Aerospace / Defense application involves satellite payloads or frequency converters, the confirmed R&S ZNA capability for group delay measurement on frequency converters without LO access is relevant, because the satellite payload passage explicitly names this R&S ZNA use case [32].
